heading: Director of Public Health of District of Columbia: report
lead: In addition to the usual number of the report of the Director of Public Health of the District of Columbia, one thousand five hundred copies shall be printed: one hundred for the Senate, three hundred and sixty for the House of Representatives, and one thousand and forty for the Director of Public Health.

notes.text: Historical and Revision NotesBased on 44 U.S. Code, 1964 ed., § 263 (Jan. 12, 1895, ch. 23, § 73, 28 Stat. 614; Aug. 1, 1950, ch. 513, § 1, 64 Stat. 393).
